title: Sindhu to Partner Tanisha Crasto in Asian Games Doubles, Singles Quarterfinal Set
indian_angle: India's top shuttler PV Sindhu will be playing women's doubles with Tanisha Crasto at the Asian Games, a rare occurrence for the singles specialist, alongside her singles quarterfinal match.
summary: Two-time Olympic medallist PV Sindhu is set to partner Tanisha Crasto in women's doubles at the Asian Games 2026. She will also open her singles last-eight clash against Akane Yamaguchi of Japan.

title: BAI Level-1 Advanced Coaches Course Underway in Guwahati and Raipur
indian_angle: The Badminton Association of India is conducting an advanced coaching course at its National Centers of Excellence, vital for developing future Indian badminton talent.
summary: The BAI Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course is currently being held from September 14-23, 2026, at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur, focusing on enhancing coaching standards across India.

title: BAI Invites Applications for Players of Outstanding Merit
indian_angle: The Badminton Association of India is accepting applications for its 'Players of Outstanding Merit' recognition, a significant honor for Indian shuttlers.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has opened applications for players to be recognized under the 'Outstanding Merit' category, acknowledging their significant contributions and achievements in the sport.

title: BAI Releases Regulations for Inter State Team Championships 2026
indian_angle: New regulations have been issued for the Inter State Team Championships 2026, a key domestic tournament for Indian badminton players.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has published the official regulations for the upcoming Inter State Team Championships 2026, outlining rules and guidelines for the prestigious domestic event.

title: Indian Junior Team Coaching Camp for Asia U17 & U15 Championships Begins
indian_angle: A national coaching camp for the Indian U17 and U15 junior teams is underway at Guwahati, preparing young Indian talent for the upcoming Badminton Asia Junior Championships.
summary: The National Center of Excellence in Guwahati is hosting a coaching camp for the Indian U17 and U15 junior teams, in preparation for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026.
